T: Faith is believing. Dinner is eating.
D: A kindly old man hired as a department store Santa insists he's the real thing, and ends up in court.
P: Serve the mains when Kris shares Thanksgiving dinner with Doris and Susan.
S: warming up along the 1947 Thanksgiving parade route
Chestnuts scored with a cross, roasted at 220C for 25 minutes, wrapped in a tea towel and peeled warm.
the long line to sit on Santa's knee
Butter shortbread cut into rounds, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced with a red Santa hat and white trim.
a mid-century New York cocktail spread
Celery sticks filled with cream cheese whipped with blue cheese and chives, and crackers with sharp cheddar.
M: the Thanksgiving Kris spends with Doris and Susan
Turkey breast brined overnight, roasted at 170C to 70C, rested, with cornbread stuffing, cranberry sauce, mashed potato and gravy.
Beef chuck seared, onion, carrot and celery, red wine and stock, braised at 160C for 3 hours, potatoes for the last hour.
W: Christmas in the house Susan wished for
Dried fruit soaked overnight in brandy, mixed with butter, brown sugar, eggs, breadcrumbs, flour and spice, steamed 4 hours, flamed at the table. Custard.
K: Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel for 15 minutes, ladled hot into mugs.

s.note: warming up along the 1947 Thanksgiving parade route
s.how: Score a cross in 600g chestnuts and roast at 220C for 25 minutes until the shells curl open. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes to steam, then peel while warm and serve in paper cones with a pinch of sea salt flakes.

s.note: a mid-century New York cocktail spread
s.how: Beat 250g cream cheese with 50g blue cheese and snipped chives until smooth. Cut celery into short sticks and pipe or spoon the filling along each. Serve on a platter beside crackers topped with slices of vintage cheddar, the way a 1940s party did it.

m.how: Sear a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots and 2 celery sticks, then 250ml red wine and enough water to come halfway. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g potatoes for the last hour. Slice and serve with the juices.

w.note: Christmas in the house Susan wished for
w.how: Soak 500g mixed dried fruit in 100ml brandy overnight. Mix with 125g melted butter, 125g brown sugar, 2 eggs, breadcrumbs, flour and mixed spice. Steam in a greased basin for 4 hours. Warm a little brandy, pour over, light at the table and serve with custard.

d.how: Pour 2L cloudy apple juice into a pot with 3 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and a few strips of orange peel. Simmer gently for 15 minutes so the spices come through. Ladle hot into mugs, leaving the spices behind, and wrap your hands around it.
